Paragraph: Summary of Passage: This supreme science was handed down through a chain of disciplic succession, but over time the continuity broke and the original core understanding appeared to be lost.
Situation/Problem_Faced: The disruption of authentic spiritual lineage and the resulting misinterpretation of core life truths.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Krishna identifies the problem: 'evam parampara-praptam... sa kaleneha mahata yogo nastah parantapa' (This science was received in disciplic succession, but by influence of time it was lost).
Outcome/Resolution: Sets the necessity for Krishna to personally re-establish the authentic tradition through a qualified recipient.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Loss of Authentic Connection: Feeling disconnected from true source principles
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Cultural/Spiritual Fragmentation: The breakdown of stabilizing communal and traditional wisdom
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Need for Restorative Practice: Rebuilding authentic mental and spiritual routines after disruption

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Evam parampara-praptam rajarsayo viduh (Saintly kings understood this science received through disciplic succession)
Yogo nastah parantapa (The yoga appears lost over time)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: The authentic yoga tradition was preserved by saintly kings but became obscured over time when the lineage broke, requiring divine restoration.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: When foundational principles are corrupted by noise or self-interest, mental confusion arises; regaining clarity requires returning to authentic, unadulterated wisdom sources.
